parameter_notes.spray_reference: Calmet et al. 2019, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0221330: 18 m/s, 40 degree half angle, sigma_g 2.08, Dv50 cases 10-150 um; breath-hold condition. The idealized spray implementation uses Schiller-Naumann spherical drag.
parameter_notes.mucus_reference: Shang et al. 2021, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0246007: mucus gel thickness 10 um; mean main-passage transport 6 mm/min. The model uses uniform speed in a 60 mm strip and a 10 um accessible mucus layer.
parameter_notes.scenario_parameters: Geometry, dose, 10-150 um droplet truncation, diffusion, attachment Da, detachment, culturability, and growth define the simulation scenario. Four strains share the default biological parameters.
parameter_notes.scope: Breath-hold idealized spray, 2D x-z mucus transport, and reversible epithelial attachment, following Eq 2,5,13-15,17,21-22,31 of the design document.
parameter_notes.growth_input: One 47-point OD600 trajectory per WT, Lp-NAC, Lp-SFN, and Lp-Q on Sheet1 over 0-23.5008 h; each strain is one fitting unit. Fit the Logistic curve with smooth startup by nonlinear least squares. The post-deposition coupling uses the Logistic limit, including its initial growth rate, for startup times at or below 1e-6 h.
